statement: The United States and Iran each publicly confirm a newly concluded agreement to end their war or halt hostilities between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if, between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-31, the White House or State Department and the Iranian government each confirm a newly concluded ceasefire, memorandum, or war-ending agreement between the two states, per Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: By 2026-12-31 the United States and Iran had not both confirmed a newly concluded ceasefire, memorandum, or war-ending agreement between them.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its scheduled meeting concluding on 2026-12-09.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC statement released on 2026-12-09 announces a higher target range, equivalently FRED series DFEDTARU for 2026-12-10 exceeds its 2026-12-08 value; FALSE if the range is held or cut.
failure_condition: The FOMC held or lowered the federal funds target range at the meeting concluding on 2026-12-09, or announced no decision that day.

statement: WTI crude (FRED series DCOILWTICO) records a daily value below 90.00 dollars per barrel on at least one day between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-31. Reference: WTI 102.60 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if any DCOILWTICO daily observation dated 2026-11-02 through 2026-12-31, as published on FRED at the deadline, is below 90.00; FALSE otherwise. Reference: 102.60 dollars per barrel at seal.
failure_condition: Every DCOILWTICO daily value from 2026-11-02 through 2026-12-31 was at or above 90.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: CISA adds at least one Oracle E-Business Suite vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-28 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed, fetched on the deadline, holds an entry with vendorProject Oracle, product E-Business Suite, and dateAdded from 2026-10-28 through 2026-12-11 inclusive; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: CISA did not add any Oracle E-Business Suite vulnerability to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-10-28 and 2026-12-11.

statement: A University of New Mexico health entity submits a HIPAA breach report to the HHS Office for Civil Rights with a breach submission date between 2026-10-28 and 2027-01-08.
resolution: TRUE if the HHS OCR breach portal, checked on the deadline, lists a covered entity whose name contains UNM or University of New Mexico with a breach submission date between 2026-10-28 and 2027-01-08; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No University of New Mexico health entity had a HIPAA breach report with a submission date between 2026-10-28 and 2027-01-08 on file and publicly posted by HHS OCR by 2027-01-15.

statement: A new Israeli government formed after the 2026-10-27 Knesset election wins a Knesset confidence vote between 2026-10-29 and 2027-02-26.
resolution: TRUE if the Knesset approves a new government in a confidence vote held between 2026-10-29 and 2027-02-26, per the Knesset official website or Reuters, Times of Israel, or Haaretz reporting; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No new Israeli government won a Knesset confidence vote between 2026-10-29 and 2027-02-26.

statement: Oscar Puente leaves office as the Spanish Minister of Transport and Sustainable Mobility between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the Boletin Oficial del Estado publishes a royal decree dated between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-31 ending the appointment of Oscar Puente as Minister of Transport and Sustainable Mobility; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: Oscar Puente still held the post of Minister of Transport and Sustainable Mobility at the close of 2026-12-31.

statement: No candidate wins more than 50 percent in the 2026-11-03 Georgia US Senate general election, sending the race to a runoff.
resolution: TRUE if Georgia Secretary of State results (certified, or final unofficial if certification is pending) for the 2026-11-03 US Senate general election show no candidate above 50 percent; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: A candidate received more than 50 percent of the votes cast in the 2026-11-03 Georgia US Senate general election.

statement: The Southwark Crown Court jury in the Russell Brand sexual offences trial returns a verdict on at least one count between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if, between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-11, the jury returns a guilty or not guilty verdict on at least one count against Russell Brand, as reported by BBC News, PA Media, or the Guardian; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: By 2026-12-11 the jury had returned no verdict on any count, because the trial was still running, was halted, or the jury was discharged without verdicts.

statement: Cumulative confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reach 12500 or more, with data up to a date between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if a WHO, Africa CDC, or ECDC update published by the deadline reports at least 12500 cumulative confirmed Ebola cases in DRC, with data up to a date between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-11; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: DRC cumulative confirmed Ebola cases, counting data through 2026-12-11, stood below 12500.
